name: Crocolisk Skin (Classic)
summary: At Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan, hunters brave the Loch’s crocolisks for hides sought by merchants and leatherworkers.

sections.title: A Dangerous Trade
sections.body: Crocolisks make dens along the islands and shores of the Loch’s cold waters. Their sharp teeth and thick scales make them dangerous quarry. Still, hunters based at Farstrider Lodge pursue them for their tough skins. Tailors and distant merchants seek the hides for sturdy garments and armor, so an undamaged skin brings a good price nearby.

faq.q: Where do crocolisk skins come from?
faq.answer: Loch Crocolisks and Large Loch Crocolisks provide the skins. They live in Loch Modan’s waters and on its islands.

faq.q: Who buys or trades these hides in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart, a dwarven hunter at Farstrider Lodge, gathers crocolisk skins and meat to sell to visiting merchants and craftsmen.

faq.q: Why are these skins in demand?
aliases: what are croc skins used for
faq.answer: Merchants seek the tough, scaly hides for sturdy clothing and armor. Crocolisks are fierce and hard to kill, so good skins bring steady pay.

faq.q: Is hunting crocolisks in the Loch considered dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. Loch crocolisks are aggressive, with powerful jaws and serrated teeth that can sever limbs. Local hunters such as Marek Ironheart trade tales of near-fatal encounters while trying to pin down their quarry.

angles.text: As a hunter, you earn Farstrider Lodge’s respect by wading to the islands and subduing a thrashing crocolisk for its hide.
As a dwarf, you know Loch Modan’s crocolisks test the grit of mountaineers and lodge woodsmen.
